AWSmaintenance.title: AWS Maintenance
AWSmaintenance.sub: Routine preventive maintenance for REMCI-UV automatic weather stations. Regular inspections help ensure reliable meteorological observations, sensor longevity, and uninterrupted telemetry.

checklist.solarPanelAndVoltage: Inspect solar panel and battery voltage
checklist.cleanRadAndTemp: Clean radiation shield and temperature sensor
checklist.rainGauge: Verify rain gauge is free of debris
checklist.anemomenter: Check anemometer rotation and wind vane alignment
checklist.corosion: Inspect cables and connectors for corrosion
checklist.stability: Check station leveling and mounting stability
